title: Create GitHub repo, license, README, docs
detail: Public repo, Apache-2.0, README, PRD/HLD/LLD/TASKS committed.
acceptance: Repo public; docs render; LICENSE detected by GitHub.

title: Go module + repo layout
detail: Create Go module and directory layout per LLD §1 with placeholder packages.
acceptance: `go build ./...` passes; layout matches LLD.

title: CI pipeline
detail: GitHub Actions: lint (golangci-lint), test, race detector, govulncheck, build on PR.
acceptance: PR shows green checks; failing test blocks merge.

title: Supply-chain hygiene
detail: Dependabot, pinned action SHAs, SECURITY.md, CODEOWNERS, branch protection.
acceptance: Branch protection on main; Dependabot PRs appear.

title: Core data model
detail: Implement ActionRequest, IntentSummary, EnrichedRequest, Decision, AuditRecord structs + JSON schema in spec/.
acceptance: Round-trip JSON tests; schemas validate fixtures.

title: JCS canonicalisation + hashing utils
detail: RFC 8785 canonical JSON; payload_hash and record hash helpers.
acceptance: Matches RFC 8785 test vectors.

title: Cedar spike
detail: Prototype cedar-go with Stopbar schema; validate decimal/set context and escalate-annotation approach.
acceptance: Spike doc in docs/adr/0001-cedar.md with go/no-go.

title: Decision token spec
detail: Write spec/decision-token-v1.md (JWS claims, payload binding, expiry, nonce).
acceptance: Spec merged; test vectors included.

title: ADR log
detail: docs/adr with ADRs: enforcement modes, Go, Cedar, fail-closed.
acceptance: 4 ADRs merged.

title: HTTP gateway skeleton
detail: /v1/evaluate, /healthz, /metrics; JSON schema validation; size limits.
acceptance: Invalid requests 400 with typed code; tests.

title: Nonce + TTL checks
detail: Nonce store (bbolt) with TTL; clock-skew window.
acceptance: Replayed nonce -> NONCE_REPLAYED; expired -> EXPIRED.

title: API key auth (dev) + mTLS option
detail: API key for sidecar; mTLS with client cert identity for service mode.
acceptance: Unauthenticated -> 401; identity propagated to actor.

title: Engine orchestration
detail: Pipeline normalize->decode->enrich->policy->limiter->sign->audit with fail-closed mapping.
acceptance: Any component error -> deny with FAIL_CLOSED_*; panic recovered.

title: Commit/release endpoints
detail: /v1/actions/{id}/commit and /release wired to limiter.
acceptance: Reservation lifecycle e2e test passes.

title: Cedar schema + loader
detail: Load .cedar files + schema; validate; compute bundle hash.
acceptance: Invalid policy rejected with line number; hash stable across file order.

title: Outcome combiner
detail: Deny/escalate/allow via @outcome annotations; default deny; reasons list.
acceptance: Table tests for all combinations.

title: Starter policy pack
detail: examples/policies/agent-wallet.cedar per LLD §5.3.
acceptance: All seed corpus attacks get expected outcome.

title: Policy dry-run
detail: `stopbar policy test` against corpus + recorded requests.
acceptance: Diff of outcomes printed; non-zero exit on regression.

title: Activation + cooling-off
detail: Signed activation; loosening caps delayed by configurable period.
acceptance: Loosening change inactive until delay passes; audited.

title: Sliding-window counters
detail: Sub-bucket windows for {usd,count} per scope key (bbolt impl).
acceptance: Rollover tests pass; no double count.

title: Reserve/commit/release
detail: Atomic reservations with TTL and janitor.
acceptance: Property test: 1,000 concurrent reserves never exceed cap.

title: Per-tx and % balance caps
detail: Absolute and pct_of_balance caps via policy context + limiter config.
acceptance: OpenClaw fixture escalates.

title: Circuit breaker
detail: Tenant outflow breaker; M-of-N reset via CLI.
acceptance: Breach -> CIRCUIT_OPEN until reset; alert metric emitted.

title: Price oracle client
detail: Chainlink + CoinGecko with staleness bound and cache.
acceptance: Stale -> price_stale=true; tests with fake clock.

title: Balance provider
detail: RPC balance reads (native + ERC-20) with cache.
acceptance: Anvil test returns correct balances.

title: Destination registry
detail: Known destinations per tenant; similarity check (prefix/suffix).
acceptance: Poisoned address flagged similar_to_known.

title: EVM decoder core
detail: Native, ERC-20/721/1155, Permit2, multicall, Safe execTransaction; recursion depth 4.
acceptance: Golden tests for each type.

title: Risk flags
detail: unlimited_approval, delegatecall, proxy_upgrade, new/similar destination, first_time_contract, opaque, unknown_call.
acceptance: Each flag has positive + negative test.

title: Human renderer + checksum phrase
detail: Plain-language template + 6-word address checksum.
acceptance: Snapshot tests; look-alike addresses yield different phrases.

title: Destructive-action flags + salami caps
detail: min_out_zero and excessive_slippage flags for known swap routers; default per-destination count cap for non-allowlisted destinations.
acceptance: Zero-min-out swap fixture denied; 6 sub-cap transfers to new destination escalate.

title: Decoder fuzzing
detail: Go native fuzz targets on calldata.
acceptance: 24h fuzz run with no panics.

title: Approver keys + CLI approvals
detail: Ed25519 approver keys; `stopbar approve/reject <id>` signs over payload_hash.
acceptance: Wrong hash or key rejected; quorum honoured.

title: Escalation lifecycle
detail: Create, poll (/v1/decisions), timeout -> deny, reject -> deny.
acceptance: E2E: escalate -> approve -> signed tx returned.

title: Decision signer (JWS Ed25519)
detail: Sign decisions; JWKS endpoint; local key provider (dev-only guard). Blocked by CS-102: once Stopbar signs, a replayed request is a replayed signature.
acceptance: Tokens verify with published JWKS; prod mode refuses local key.

title: Gatekeeper local signer adapter
detail: Holds agent keystore; verifies decision token + payload_hash before signing.
acceptance: Signing without valid token impossible (test).

title: AWS KMS signer + decision key
detail: KMS secp256k1 for tx signing; KMS for decision key.
acceptance: Integration test against KMS (or localstack).

title: Turnkey adapter
detail: Gatekeeper via Turnkey API key held only by Stopbar.
acceptance: Sandbox org test passes.

title: Hash-chained log
detail: Append-only bbolt bucket; record per event in same tx as state change.
acceptance: Tampering one record fails verify.

title: Checkpoints + verify CLI
detail: Signed Merkle checkpoints; `stopbar audit verify`.
acceptance: Verify passes clean log, fails tampered.

title: TypeScript SDK
detail: Client, context API with labels, evaluate/commit/release, typed errors.
acceptance: Example agent protected end-to-end.

title: Python SDK
detail: Parity with TS SDK.
acceptance: Same example in Python passes.

title: Encoding detector
detail: Detect base64/hex/Morse/ROT-n/zero-width in untrusted inputs -> add 'decoded'.
acceptance: Grok-pattern fixture labelled decoded.

title: Framework integrations
detail: Wrappers for one agent framework + viem/ethers signer shim.
acceptance: Drop-in signer replacement demo.

title: Corpus schema
detail: corpus/schema.json finalized; validator CLI.
acceptance: All seed attacks validate.

title: Replay harness
detail: Seed state from setup; evaluate; assert outcome + policy_ids; CI job.
acceptance: CI fails when a policy regression unblocks an attack.

title: 10 seed attacks
detail: Grok/Bankr encoded injection; Bankr unauthorised signing; OpenClaw over-transfer; unlimited approval; delegatecall (Bybit pattern); proxy upgrade; address poisoning; velocity drain; stale-price under-valuation; multicall-hidden transfer.
acceptance: All 10 present and blocked/escalated as expected.

title: CLI: init
detail: `stopbar init --persona agent-wallet` generates config + policies + keys.
acceptance: Fresh machine to protected agent < 30 min (timed).

title: Docker image + binaries
detail: goreleaser; signed releases (cosign); SBOM.
acceptance: Release artifacts signed and verifiable.

title: Benchmarks
detail: Latency/throughput benchmarks vs. NFR-1/2.
acceptance: p99 < 25ms sidecar at 1k rps published in docs.

title: Quickstart + E2E demo
detail: Anvil + sample agent + attack replay video/GIF.
acceptance: Demo reproducible from README.

title: Contribution flow for attacks
detail: PR template, auto-validation, labels, CONTRIBUTING.
acceptance: External contributor can add an attack without help.

title: Docs site
detail: MkDocs/Docusaurus from docs/; spec pages.
acceptance: Site live via GitHub Pages.

title: Slack/Telegram escalation channels
detail: Push rendered intent + signing link.
acceptance: Approve from phone e2e.

title: Launch
detail: Write-up of thesis + incident analysis; HN/X/LinkedIn; outreach to 20 agent builders.
acceptance: Launch posted; metrics dashboard live.

title: Design partners
detail: Recruit 3 agent-wallet teams for shadow (advisory) mode.
acceptance: 3 partners running advisory mode with feedback logged.

title: Kill/pivot review
detail: Review month-3 metrics vs PRD §11.
acceptance: Written decision: continue / pivot.

title: Threat-tier ADR
detail: docs/adr/0005-threat-tiers.md: T1-T4 definitions, harness-vs-model trust boundary, which controls hold per tier.
acceptance: ADR merged; PRD §2.4 and HLD §8 reference it.

title: Tool-call policy schema + AgentDojo pack
detail: Cedar context for tool_call (tool, recipient_external, amount, taint); examples/policies/agentdojo.cedar written before viewing injection tasks.
acceptance: Bundle validates; hash frozen and recorded.

title: AgentDojo defence adapter
detail: Python adapter: tool call -> ActionRequest -> /v1/evaluate; block returns tool error with reason codes.
acceptance: Benign banking suite runs end-to-end through stopbard.

title: Harness provenance labelling
detail: Label user prompt, tool outputs and AgentDojo injectable fields; session-level taint.
acceptance: Injected-field outputs carry untrusted_* labels in the shadow log.

title: LLM monitor
detail: Versioned monitor prompt; frontier + open-weight model; threshold set on held-out calibration split.
acceptance: Monitor verdicts reproducible at temperature 0 on a fixed sample.

title: Shadow logging
detail: Record policy and monitor verdicts on every call in every arm (JSONL schema §18.5).
acceptance: Schema-validated log; both verdicts present for 100% of calls.

title: Four-arm runner
detail: A0-A3 across suites, attacks, seeds; pinned run config; `make eval`.
acceptance: Full matrix runs from one command; results folder reproducible.

title: Metrics + analysis
detail: Benign utility, utility under attack, ASR, disagreement matrix, bootstrap CIs, latency per arm.
acceptance: Notebook regenerates all tables/figures from raw JSONL.

title: Adaptive attacker
detail: Attacker LLM with policy text + denial reasons, N=10 attempts; tries allowlist routing, amount splitting, ungated tools.
acceptance: Adaptive ASR reported per arm with examples of successful bypasses.

title: Scheming-agent (T4) setting
detail: Covert side task in agent system prompt with user task as cover; no injection.
acceptance: T4 containment reported for A0 vs A2.

title: Results write-up
detail: Preliminary report: method, results, failure cases, limitations; reproducibility package.
acceptance: Published (repo + LessWrong/arXiv); every number traceable to a run folder.

title: Binding wrapper runtime (TS)
detail: Instrumented bindings for sandboxed scripts; each call -> ActionRequest(tool_call).
acceptance: Script calls blocked by policy raise exception inside sandbox.

title: Field-level taint propagation
detail: Tainted<T> wrappers + propagation through derived values.
acceptance: Exfil fixture (crm.export -> email.send external) denied.

title: Python binding runtime
detail: Parity for Python sandboxes.
acceptance: Same fixtures pass.

title: MCP gateway adapter
detail: Enforce policy on MCP tool calls at a gateway.
acceptance: MCP server calls evaluated with taint.

title: Static pre-execution checks
detail: Flag loops over sensitive bindings feeding network calls before running.
acceptance: Pre-check catches seeded exfil script.

title: Postgres + Redis store
detail: Production stores; Lua reserve script.
acceptance: Concurrency property tests pass on Redis.

title: Code-mode corpus
detail: 10 attacks: loop exfil, injected script, tool chaining, etc.
acceptance: All blocked.

title: StopbarGuard (Safe Guard)
detail: Solidity guard verifying EIP-712 countersignature + nonce.
acceptance: Foundry tests; external audit scheduled.

title: MPC share integration
detail: Stopbar as one share holder with an MPC provider.
acceptance: Tx impossible without Stopbar share in test.

title: HSM / Nitro Enclave decision key
detail: PKCS#11 and enclave key providers; attestation.
acceptance: Key never leaves HSM/enclave; attestation verified.

title: Deploy-event ingestion
detail: /v1/events/deploy; minutes_since_code_change; unsigned artifact -> deny.
acceptance: Binance-pattern fixture escalates/denies.

title: HA mode
detail: Active/passive with shared store; fail-closed failover.
acceptance: Chaos test: failover with no cap violations.

title: Passkey approvals
detail: WebAuthn approvals bound to payload_hash.
acceptance: Approve via passkey e2e.

title: Solana support
detail: Decoder + signer adapter for Solana.
acceptance: Seed Solana attacks blocked.

title: External security audit
detail: Independent audit of core + guard.
acceptance: Report published; criticals fixed.
